SELECT p.ID, AVG(l.UA) AS avg_uric_acid, AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_hematocrit
FROM Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS lr
    WHERE lr.ID = p.ID AND lr.RA = '-'
)
GROUP BY p.ID
ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(l.HCT) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         AVG(l.HCT) DESC
LIMIT 10
